additional_info.subject: RE: ID0438145-DC/Si-D/NZ-[MP / P3 170000341] Estop released,charger still offline CRM:02888000153
additional_info.body:
Good evening Liz,
I am reaching out from the Expert Team in regards of ticket
ID0438145.
The ticket was opened today for a loss of connectivity to the OCPP Backend for charger
170000341
, after the Emergency Stop button was pressed.
From both a HW and FW point of view, there is no correlation between pressing/releasing the emergency stop button and the wired connectivity of XF4 to the OCPP Backend.
In the logs it is possible to notice that the connection to the OCPP Backend fell at 2025-07-16T19:17:51, while the emergency stop button was pressed at 2025-07-16T19:23:37.
When I received the ticket this morning, I connected via SSH to the router and verified that the wired connection was fine. I rebooted the charger (triggering a boot notification) and now the charger is connected again to the OCPP Backend.
Since the issue is solved, I will proceed to close this ticket. Please do not hesitate to open a new ticket in case this behavior happens more frequently, or if a reboot does not re-establish the communication to the Backend.
